entry.content:
• Added support for POSTGRES_19 as a version in alloydb clusters create for alpha and beta tracks.
  • Added support for POSTGRES_19 as a version in alloydb clusters migrate-cloud-sql for alpha and beta tracks.
entry.summary: AlloyDB now supports PostgreSQL 19 for alpha and beta tracks. This includes support for cluster creation and Cloud SQL migration. This enhancement allows users to leverage the latest PostgreSQL features with AlloyDB.
entry.title: AlloyDB: AlloyDB adds support for PostgreSQL 19

entry.content:
• Fixed an issue where gcloud apigee apis import --from-template nested <FaultRule> and <DefaultFaultRule> steps inside a <Request> element, which caused the generated fault rules to run no steps. Steps are now emitted as direct children, and fault rules are read correctly in either form when importing a bundle.
  • Modified gcloud apigee apis import --from-template to ignore the mode field when it is set on a fault rule and to log a warning. The field applies only to flows.
entry.summary: The Apigee import command has been updated to correctly handle fault rules, ensuring that nested steps are properly processed and that the `mode` field is ignored on fault rules. This resolves an issue where imported fault rules might not execute any steps.
entry.title: Apigee: Apigee import improvements

entry.content:
• Added support for --service_directory_service flag for bq mk --connection and bq update --connection commands for Azure connections.
  • Deprecated --s3_service_directory_service flag. Use --service_directory_service instead for bq mk --connection and bq update --connection commands for AWS connections.
  • Added creationTime and updateTime to be displayed in bq show for reservation group.
  • Added --precedence and --condition flags to bq mk and bq update for reservation assignments.
entry.summary: New flags for Azure and AWS connections in BigQuery improve service directory integration. Reservation assignments now support precedence and condition flags, and reservation groups display creation and update times.
entry.title: BigQuery: BigQuery Connection Updates

entry.content: • Promoted gcloud access-context-manager lookup-configured-perimeter to beta and GA.
entry.summary: The `lookup-configured-perimeter` command for Access Context Manager is now available in beta and general availability. This command helps you to easily retrieve information about your configured perimeters.
entry.title: Cloud Access Context Manager: Access Context Manager: new commands available

entry.content: • Rebuilding cbt emulator with go version 1.25.9 which fixed CVE-2026-27140.
entry.summary: The Cloud Bigtable emulator has been rebuilt using Go 1.25.9. This update includes a fix for CVE-2026-27140, enhancing the security of the emulator.
entry.title: Cloud Bigtable Emulator: Bigtable emulator updated

entry.content:
• Added gcloud beta composer environments hibernate command to hibernate a Cloud Composer environment.
  • Added gcloud beta composer environments resume command to resume a Cloud Composer environment.
  • Added --enable-development-mode flag to gcloud beta composer environments create to enable development mode for environments.
entry.summary: Manage your Cloud Composer environments more efficiently with new commands for hibernating and resuming environments. You can now also enable development mode during environment creation using the `--enable-development-mode` flag.
entry.title: Cloud Composer: New environment management features

entry.content:
• Added an interactive prompt when creating or updating Cloud Run jobs configured with GPUs and task timeouts greater than 1 hour in gcloud beta run jobs command group.
  • Added --identity-certificate, --identity-type, and --functional-type flags to the beta track for gcloud run deploy and gcloud run services update to configure workloads with Agent Registry and Agent Identity.
  • Added --identity-certificate, --identity-type, and --functional-type flags to gcloud beta run jobs command groups to configure workloads with Agent Registry and Agent Identity.
entry.summary: Cloud Run now offers an interactive prompt for configuring GPU and long-running jobs, alongside new flags for enhanced workload identity management with Agent Registry. These updates streamline job creation and improve security for your containerized applications.
entry.title: Cloud Run: Cloud Run Enhancements for Jobs and Workloads

entry.content: • Updated 'cloud-sql-proxy' packaged component to use 2.25.3 of the Cloud SQL Proxy.
entry.summary: The Cloud SQL Proxy has been updated to version 2.25.3. This update ensures you are using the latest version of the proxy for secure and reliable connections to Cloud SQL instances.
entry.title: Cloud SQL: Cloud SQL Proxy Updated

entry.content: • Tuned download performance for gRPC bidi streaming used by RAPID storage in gcloud storage.
entry.summary: Download performance for gRPC bidi streaming in `gcloud storage` has been optimized. This update improves the speed of your storage operations.
entry.title: Cloud Storage: Faster Cloud Storage Downloads

entry.content:
• Fixed an issue where creating a cluster using --quickstart-cluster (or any other reference architecture) would automatically inject default storage resources (such as managed Lustre) even when custom storage configurations (e.g. --filestores) were explicitly specified.
  • Promoted gcloud cluster-director to GA.
entry.summary: Cluster Director is now generally available. A fix has been implemented to ensure custom storage configurations are respected when creating clusters with reference architectures.
entry.title: Cluster Director: Cluster Director GA and Storage Fix

entry.content:
• Added --no-graceful-shutdown flag to gcloud compute instance-groups managed stop-instances command across all release tracks.
  • Added --no-graceful-shutdown flag to gcloud compute instance-groups managed delete-instances command across all release tracks.
  • Added --no-graceful-shutdown flag to gcloud compute instance-groups managed recreate-instances command across all release tracks.
  • Added --no-graceful-shutdown flag to gcloud compute instance-groups managed delete command across all release tracks.
  • Added --outlier-detection-* flags to gcloud compute backend-services create and update commands to configure outlier detection settings.
  • Promoted gcloud compute recoverable-snapshots recover to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute recoverable-snapshots delete to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute recoverable-snapshots describe to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute recoverable-snapshots list to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute recoverable-snapshots set-iam-policy to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute recoverable-snapshots test-iam-permissions to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute snapshot-recycle-bin-policy describe to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute snapshot-recycle-bin-policy patch to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute snapshots get-effective-recycle-bin-rule to beta.
entry.summary: The latest Compute Engine update introduces a new --no-graceful-shutdown flag for managed instance group operations and promotes several recoverable snapshot commands to beta. Additionally, new outlier detection flags are available for backend services.
entry.title: Compute Engine: New Compute Engine features

entry.content: • Added support for homogeneous MySQL destination connection profiles for quickstart migrations in gcloud database-migration connection-profiles create mysql and gcloud database-migration connection-profiles update.
entry.summary: Users can now create and update homogeneous MySQL destination connection profiles for quickstart migrations using gcloud database-migration commands. This simplifies the initial setup for migrating MySQL databases.
entry.title: Database Migration: Quickstart MySQL Migrations Now Supported

entry.content:
• Promoted gcloud edge-cloud zones describe, get-iam-policy, list, roles list, and set-iam-policy to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud edge-cloud services describe, enable, and list to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud edge-cloud projects describe, enable, and list to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud edge-cloud service-accounts create, delete, describe, and list to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud edge-cloud service-accounts keys create, describe, disable, and list to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud edge-cloud api-keys create, delete, describe, and list to GA.
  • Promoted --control-plane-node-system-partition-size-gib flag from alpha to GA for edge-cloud container clusters create.
entry.summary: Key command-line interface tools for managing Distributed Cloud Edge resources, including zones, services, projects, service accounts, and API keys, have now reached General Availability. This includes features for creating, describing, listing, and managing IAM policies and service account keys. Additionally, the `--control-plane-node-system-partition-size-gib` flag for creating container clusters is now GA.
entry.title: Distributed Cloud Edge: Distributed Cloud Edge CLI commands reach General Availability

entry.content:
• Added --ignore-maintenance-policies, --ignore-cluster-disruption-budgets, --soak-duration-overrides-per-stage and --soak-duration-override-all-stages flags to gcloud beta container fleet rolloutsequences upgrade.
  • Added --patch-only flag to gcloud beta container fleet rolloutsequences upgrade.
entry.summary: New flags have been added to `gcloud beta container fleet rolloutsequences upgrade` to provide more control over upgrade processes. These include options to ignore maintenance policies and disruption budgets, and to customize soak durations. Additionally, a `--patch-only` flag is now available for patch upgrades.
entry.title: GKE Hub: New GKE Hub Rollout Sequence Flags

entry.content:
• Updated default kubectl from 1.35.6 to 1.35.7.
  • Additional kubectl versions:
  • 1.31.14
  • 1.32.13
  • 1.33.13
  • 1.34.11
  • 1.35.8
  • 1.36.4
entry.summary: Kubernetes Engine now supports kubectl versions 1.31 through 1.36, with the default version updated to 1.35.7. This update includes the latest patch releases for each supported minor version.
entry.title: Kubernetes Engine: Kubernetes Engine kubectl update

entry.content:
• Promoted gcloud network-services telemetry-policies delete to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud network-services telemetry-policies describe and gcloud network-services telemetry-policies list to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud network-services telemetry-policies export and gcloud network-services telemetry-policies import to beta.
entry.summary: The gcloud network-services telemetry-policies commands for delete, describe, list, export, and import have been promoted to Beta. This update brings enhanced network observability and management capabilities to users.
entry.title: Network Services: Network Services Telemetry Policies reach Beta

entry.content: • Added BUNDLE_ID as a default variable to allow dynamic referencing in pipeline configurations. BUNDLE_ID resolves to the Git repository name, auto-generated local bundle name, or the current working directory name as a fallback. Used in gcloud orchestration-pipelines deploy command.
entry.summary: Orchestration Pipelines now supports BUNDLE_ID as a default variable. This variable dynamically references your Git repository name, auto-generated bundle name, or current working directory, simplifying pipeline configuration. It is used with the `gcloud orchestration-pipelines deploy` command.
entry.title: Orchestration Pipelines: Bundle ID variable for pipelines

entry.content:
• Promoted --match-glob flag in transfer jobs create to GA.
  • Promoted --match-glob flag in transfer jobs update to GA.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.
entry.summary: The `--match-glob` flag for creating and updating transfer jobs has been promoted to General Availability. This enhancement allows for more flexible file matching in transfer operations.
entry.title: Transfer: Transfer jobs match glob GA
